name: anchored_oblique_slot_keeps_its_angle
why: ENTRY E18 on the oblique slot: 60 x 20 at 30 degrees, centre 60 from the right side and centred in height. Without an anchor an oblique slot has no edge to measure the angle from and can rotate; with the anchor the angle is dimensioned against its first edge (angular `AddSpecificDimension`: `Extension.AddDimension` returns null on that pair, measured). After 260 x 180 the centre must be at (100, 30) and the ends keep the 30 degrees: (82.68, 20) and (117.32, 40).

expect.tolerance_why: 40 -/+ 20*cos30 = 17.32; the centres are read in metres

expect.why: radius, distance between the centres and the angle against the anchor edge

expect.tolerance_why: the centre goes to 160 - 60 = 100, the angle does not change
centre at 30, -/+ 10: the angle stays 30 degrees
